+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+from _pytest.python_api import _as_numpy_array
+
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from numpy import ndarray
+
+
+def scalar_numpy_array(obj: object) -> ndarray | None:
+    """Like _as_numpy_array, but convert NumPy scalars to zero-dimensional arrays."""
+    np: Any = sys.modules.get("numpy")
+    if np is not None and issubclass(type(obj), np.generic):
+        return np.asarray(obj)
+    return _as_numpy_array(obj)

@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+
+from _pytest.scalar_numpy_array import scalar_numpy_array
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", ["int16", "float64", "complex128", "bool_"])
+def test_numpy_scalar(dtype: str) -> None:
+    np = pytest.importorskip("numpy")
+    scalar = getattr(np, dtype)(1)
+
+    result = scalar_numpy_array(scalar)
+
+    assert isinstance(result, np.ndarray)
+    assert result.shape == ()
+    assert result.dtype == scalar.dtype
+    assert result.item() == scalar
+
+
+def test_numpy_array_identity() -> None:
+    np = pytest.importorskip("numpy")
+    zero_dimensional = np.array(1)
+    empty = np.array([])
+
+    assert scalar_numpy_array(zero_dimensional) is zero_dimensional
+    assert scalar_numpy_array(empty) is empty
+
+
+def test_non_array_inputs() -> None:
+    pytest.importorskip("numpy")
+
+    assert scalar_numpy_array(1) is None
+    assert scalar_numpy_array([]) is None
+
+
+def test_array_protocol(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    np = pytest.importorskip("numpy")
+    array = np.array(1)
+
+    class ArrayLike:
+        def __array__(self) -> object:
+            return array
+
+    obj = ArrayLike()
+    assert scalar_numpy_array(obj) is array
+
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "numpy", None)
+    assert scalar_numpy_array(obj) is None
+
+
+def test_array_protocol_error() -> None:
+    pytest.importorskip("numpy")
+
+    class BrokenArray:
+        def __array__(self) -> object:
+            raise ValueError("conversion failed")
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="conversion failed"):
+        scalar_numpy_array(BrokenArray())
